data.name: Super-Raft Sunset Tour
data.headline: 2.5 hours • Experience the beauty of the golden hour from a new perspective
data.description: Join us aboard the Kona Explorer, our 41 ft. Super-Raft, for a 2.5-hour sunset tour along the Kona coast. Relax and enjoy front-row seats to Hawaii’s stunning coastal sunset with Hawaiian-inspired cuisine and the option to purchase alcoholic beverages. With plenty of seating and a focus on comfort, this is the perfect way to unwind and experience the beauty of the golden hour from the water.
data.highlights:
- Luxurious 41 ft. Super-Raft with comfortable seating
- Beautiful coastal sunset
- Hawaiian-inspired cuisine
- Commentary on local landmarks and marine life
data.itinerary:
- Departure from Kailua Pier
- Coastal cruise with no set destination, enjoying the scenic views
- Return to Kailua Pier after watching the sunset

Hawaiian-inspired cuisine

data.cancellation_summary: Full refund with appropriate notice based on group size; no refund for late arrivals
data.cancellation_notes: To receive a full refund, cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance for parties of 9 or fewer, 72 hours for parties of 10–19, and 7 days for parties of 20 or more. Full refunds are provided only in the event of an operator cancellation. Please note that refunds are not available for late arrivals or motion sickness, as sea conditions and individual reactions are beyond our control.
data.booking_notes:
#Mahalo for booking with Body Glove Cruises

We look forward to welcoming you for your Super-Raft Sunset Tour!

Free parking is available at our retail shop in Ilima Court Shopping Center. The address is 75-5629 Kuakini Highway, Kailua Kona, HI 96740. It's about a 5-7 minute walk down to the pier. Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure.

##Discover unique, locally made treasures in our gift shop—show this email for 10% off your purchase!
![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/3N450zzPQ66ojeJPrGyo)
***

#Boat Information:

- This tour takes place on the [Kona Explorer](https://www.bodyglovehawaii.com/our-boat), our 41 ft. Super Raft.
- Please note that our vessel is a **SMOKE FREE** vessel.
- Our boat requires you to be physically agile and able to navigate the boarding process with ease, this is to ensure the safety of all passengers and crew on board.
- If you have concerns about your ability to board the boat, we encourage you to speak with one of our crew members who will be happy to assist you in finding the best solution.

#Included On This Trip:

- Hawaiian inspired cuisine
- Front row seats to the sunset

#Special Dietary Requests:
For gluten-free, vegetarian, or vegan meals, please call 800.551.8911 at least **48 hours** before your adventure.

##Due to extreme exposure to Fun & Excitement, we unfortunately cannot welcome children five years and younger, or pregnant woman on this tour.##
